lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\IntegrationYoutube\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
The Composer autoloader is optimized beyond level 1. The manual allows only config.optimize-autoloader: an authoritative class map breaks the upgrade of the app, and APCu is no required extension.

vimeo/psalm, friendsofphp/php-cs-fixer are in require-dev of composer.json. The manual recommends a vendor-bin/ of bamarni/composer-bin-plugin per tool, so that the dependencies of a tool cannot conflict with those of the app.

lines: 1 use in 1 file of the public API that is deprecated in Nextcloud 32 to 35. The text of the tag names the replacement where it has one.
lib/Listener/ContentSecurityPolicyListener.php:44 OCP\AppFramework\Http\ContentSecurityPolicy: deprecated since Nextcloud 14; Use one of our stricter CSP policies

The app reads and writes its app config in 10 places and registers no config lexicon, which IRegistrationContext::registerConfigLexicon() takes since Nextcloud 31. A lexicon states the type, the default and the sensitivity of each key in one place.
